nat.tldr: In short: Not a Translator does not collect personal data, track your browsing, show advertising or sell data. The only information processed is used to provide definitions, illustrative images, local extension features and technical caching.

b.p: Not a Translator is a dictionary and reading-aid extension. When you hover over or select a word or expression, it can show a definition, reading assistance, pronunciation, an illustrative image, a unit or time conversion, or a console mode when the page cannot display the tooltip reliably.

To perform a lookup, the extension processes only the word or expression you choose, plus settings required for local operation. Depending on the feature, this lookup may be sent to a dictionary, image, pronunciation, lemmatization or cache service.
The extension does not intentionally transmit your name, email address, accounts, passwords, browsing history, full page content, or a list of sites you visit.

list: No personally identifiable information.
No user account in the extension.
No payment data processed by the extension.
No stored browsing history.
No geolocation requested or used.
No advertising, analytics or behavioral tracking.
No sale, rental or sharing with data brokers.

b.p: External services receive only what is necessary for the requested feature. As with any web request, they may technically see the associated IP address, but Not a Translator does not add an advertising identifier or user profile.

list: Merriam-Webster / dictionaryapi.com - English definitions.
Wiktionary - definitions, pronunciations, forms and lexical information.
RAE / DLE - Spanish definitions.
Larousse - French definitions.
DWDS - German definitions.
Dizionario Internazionale, Hoepli - Italian definitions.
Kielitoimiston sanakirja - Finnish definitions.
Logeion, Perseus - Ancient Greek and Latin resources.
LINDAT / UDPipe - lemmatization.
Google Translate, MyMemory, AdminForge - optional translation help when requested or enabled by the user.
Sound of Text - audio when pronunciation is requested.
notatr-proxy - Cloudflare proxy operated by the developer, especially to protect API keys and handle image searches.
Unsplash and Openverse - illustrative images through the proxy. Unsplash searches use the strict content filter.

b.p: The application is designed to remain suitable for children. Images from Unsplash are requested with the strict content filter. They are used only to support a definition or lexical lookup.
Images and definitions still come from external services and public resources. If inappropriate content appears, it can be reported so cache entries or lookup behavior can be corrected.

To keep the service fast and reduce repeated calls, some definitions, technical responses and image searches may be cached locally in the browser or on technical services operated by the developer. The cache is organized around the word, expression or useful request, not around a user identity.

Cached definitions may be reviewed by the developer to prevent drift, detect attacks, remove problematic content, improve service quality and follow general usage. This monitoring is not used to build individual profiles.

The extension may store required settings: enabled state, selected dictionary, display preferences, tooltip color or opacity, console-mode state, last selection needed for immediate operation and similar preferences.
These are technical settings, not browsing history. Depending on your browser and profile sync settings, some settings may be synchronized across devices by Chrome, Firefox or Safari.

The Chrome Web Store and other platforms may publish or show the developer aggregated statistics, such as user counts by operating system, country or version. These statistics come from the store and do not allow Not a Translator to identify a specific user.
Not a Translator shows no advertising. The project relies on optional donations processed outside the extension by services such as PayPal or Buy Me a Coffee.
The funding intention is: 30% of donations are given to charities, and 30% are reinvested in application development. The rest contributes to costs, maintenance time and continuity.

Not a Translator is a dictionary and reading-aid tool suitable for family and school use. The extension does not knowingly collect personal data from children and includes no advertising or behavioral tracking.

The developer may monitor caches, technical errors and abnormal use to protect the service against abuse, attacks, spam, diverted content and quality drift. This monitoring is for security and reliability, not individual tracking.
This policy may be updated as the extension evolves. The last-updated date will change accordingly.
Questions: masquages-magie0r@icloud.com

experiment.htmlTitle: Privacy Policy - Not a Translator Experiment
experiment.tldr: In short: This companion extension sends only the word or expression you hover over or select to the services needed for images, related words, SenseMap and RootMap. It does not collect your identity, browsing history or location. It does not track you, show ads or sell data.

b.p: Not a Translator Experiment enriches the Not a Translator dictionary tooltip with an illustrative image, a graph of related meanings (SenseMap) and a graph of the word family and origin (RootMap). These features are triggered only by the word or expression you hover over or select.
For a lookup, the extension transmits only the word or expression you choose. It does not transmit the current page, its URL, surrounding text, your identity or other page content.

list: No personally identifiable information.
No accounts, passwords or authentication data.
No financial or payment information.
No browsing history, visited-page list or URLs.
No geolocation.
No clicks, keystrokes, mouse tracking or analytics.
No advertising, profiling, sale or sharing with data brokers.

b.p: Each service receives only the looked-up word or expression and only for the feature it powers.

list: Wiktionary - definitions, synonyms, antonyms, word family and etymology.
notatr-proxy - Cloudflare Worker operated by the developer; caches image lookups and protects API credentials.
Unsplash and Openverse - illustrative photographs through the proxy. Unsplash uses the strict content filter.
iNaturalist, GBIF, Wikidata, Wikimedia Commons - photographs of species and objects.
OpenStreetMap / Nominatim - map thumbnails for place names.
LINDAT / UDPipe - lemmatization.

b.p: These services receive requests under their own policies. They may technically see the originating IP address; the extension does not add or store it.
Some features are reserved for donors. A donor may receive a signed key such as NTX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXXX and paste it into the popup.

The key is derived from the donor email address but does not contain it: only a salted irreversible fingerprint is embedded. It is sent only to developer services for validation and authorization, never to third-party providers.

Because the same key accompanies these checks, developer services could technically relate several requests to the same key. No log associating keys with looked-up words is kept, and the key cannot be reversed into the email address.

Results may be cached in browser memory and on the developer Cloudflare edge or cache server. The cache is keyed by word or expression, not by user identity, and may be monitored to prevent abuse, attacks and content drift.

The extension stores local settings such as enabled state, images, SenseMap and RootMap options, plus donor-key validation status where applicable. It does not store lookup history, pages or documents.
Donations are optional and handled outside the extension. If you email after donating, your address is used only to reply, send the install link and generate the donor key, not for marketing.
The extension is designed to remain child-friendly. Unsplash images use the strict content filter, and there is no advertising or behavioral tracking.
This policy may be updated as features evolve.
Questions about this policy: bongo_plats@icloud.com

pro.htmlTitle: Privacy Policy - Not a Translator Experiment Pro
pro.product: Not a Translator Experiment Pro (browser extension)
pro.tldr: In short: This extension sends only the looked-up word or expression to the needed services. The reader and PDF viewer process page and document content entirely on your device. It does not collect your identity, history or location, does not track you, show ads or sell data.

b.p: Not a Translator Experiment Pro enriches the Not a Translator tooltip with images, SenseMap and RootMap, and adds a reader and PDF viewer so the same tooltips can work in long texts and PDF documents.

sections.h: Reader and PDF viewer: local processing

list: The reader analyzes the current page in your browser to extract the article and remove menus, adverts and sidebars.
The PDF viewer downloads the PDF you explicitly choose to open from its hosting site and renders it locally.
No page content, document content or filename is sent to the developer or third parties by these features. Only individual words you look up leave the browser.

b.p: The Pro edition may request access to all sites (<all_urls>) because a PDF can be hosted on any domain and the reader works on the page you are reading. This permission is not used to inventory visited sites.
For lookups, the extension transmits only the word or expression you choose. It does not transmit the full page, URL, surrounding text, your identity or other content.
